description: Add a carton to a packing list and return its C01-style id: a label, the empty weight in WHOLE GRAMS, and optionally length, width and height in WHOLE CENTIMETRES. Dimensions are what make a chargeable weight possible.

label.description: What is written on the box, e.g. Box 1 of 3 or Pallet A

length_cm.description: Outer length in whole centimetres. All three dimensions or none

packing_list.description: The packing list id, e.g. PL-2026-0001, or the order reference when only one list carries it

tare_grams.description: The EMPTY carton with its packaging, in whole grams. 0 when it is not known

name: carton_add
title: Add a carton
